snippet.title: The King is Watching OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Your Kingdom awaits, noble ruler, in The King is Watching, OUT NOW! In this unique roguelite kingdom builder, your subjects only work when you're watching them.

Gather resources, defend against waves of goblins and beasts, and rule with one of several mighty Kings, each with their own powers and playstyle. Every run is a new royal tale!

Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753900/The_King_is_Watching/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7yf97dNPV2
Follow us on Twitter: https://x.com/TKIWGame
